title: Security regression coverage
summary: The suite increased from four to five top-level tests by adding a dedicated fail-closed security-boundary test.
evidence: Referral authorization and administrator fail-closed behavior are covered by the new boundary test.
Referral field redaction is covered in the main endpoint test.
Ask-route access gating remains covered by the beta invite test.
Provider-key separation is verified by direct code inspection and real-answer smoke, not a dedicated unit test.
limitations: Browser rendering remains tracked separately by T-014.
